crossRefs.note: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
“If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
“ ‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

translations.web: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
translations.bsb: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
translations.kjv: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
translations.asv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.
